exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Lie on a flat bench, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width, lower it to mid-chest with control, then press it back up. Targets the pecs, anterior deltoids and triceps.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The figure presses a barbell above the chest while supported by a flat bench.
exercises.sourceDescription: Lie on a flat bench, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width, lower it to mid-chest with control, then press it back up. Targets the pecs, anterior deltoids and triceps.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Press two dumbbells from a bench set to a 30-45 degree incline. Biases the upper pectoralis major and keeps constant tension through the movement.
exercises.illustrationSummary: Two dumbbells move away from and back toward the upper chest on an inclined bench.
exercises.sourceDescription: Press two dumbbells from a bench set to a 30-45 degree incline. Biases the upper pectoralis major and keeps constant tension through the movement.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.description: With a slight elbow bend, lower the dumbbells in a wide arc until a comfortable chest stretch, then bring them back together. Isolates the pecs.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The arms open and close across the chest with a modest, maintained elbow bend.
exercises.sourceDescription: With a slight elbow bend, lower the dumbbells in a wide arc until a comfortable chest stretch, then bring them back together. Isolates the pecs.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.description: From a straight-body plank, lower your chest to the floor and press back up. A foundational chest, shoulder and core exercise needing no equipment.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The body rises and lowers as one aligned segment while the elbows extend and bend.
exercises.sourceDescription: From a straight-body plank, lower your chest to the floor and press back up. A foundational chest, shoulder and core exercise needing no equipment.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.description: With pulleys set high, bring the handles down and together across your body with a slight bend in the elbows. Finishes the outer chest.
exercises.illustrationSummary: Two high cables are drawn inward and downward in front of the torso.
exercises.sourceDescription: With pulleys set high, bring the handles down and together across your body with a slight bend in the elbows. Finishes the outer chest.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.description: Press the bar from the front of your shoulders to full lockout overhead. Builds the delts, upper chest and triceps while demanding core stability.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The barbell travels from the front of the shoulders to an overhead position.
exercises.sourceDescription: Press the bar from the front of your shoulders to full lockout overhead. Builds the delts, upper chest and triceps while demanding core stability.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Seated or standing, press both dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead and lower with control. A staple for overall shoulder size.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The seated figure presses two dumbbells overhead and returns them toward the shoulders.
exercises.sourceDescription: Seated or standing, press both dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead and lower with control. A staple for overall shoulder size.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.description: With a slight elbow bend, raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height and lower slowly. Directly targets the lateral deltoid for width.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The arms lift outward toward shoulder height while the torso remains still.
exercises.sourceDescription: With a slight elbow bend, raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height and lower slowly. Directly targets the lateral deltoid for width.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.description: Hinged forward at the hips, open the arms out to the sides, squeezing the rear delts, then lower under control. Balances the rear shoulder.
exercises.illustrationSummary: From a forward hip hinge, the arms open laterally and return beneath the shoulders.
exercises.sourceDescription: Hinged forward at the hips, open the arms out to the sides, squeezing the rear delts, then lower under control. Balances the rear shoulder.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.description: Pull a rope attachment toward your face, elbows high and externally rotated at the end of the motion. Trains the rear delts and upper back.
exercises.illustrationSummary: A rope handle is drawn toward the face as the hands separate.
exercises.sourceDescription: Pull a rope attachment toward your face, elbows high and externally rotated at the end of the motion. Trains the rear delts and upper back.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.description: Keeping the elbows pinned to your sides, curl the bar up to shoulder height and lower with control. A direct biceps builder.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The barbell rises through elbow flexion while the upper arms remain close to the torso.
exercises.sourceDescription: Keeping the elbows pinned to your sides, curl the bar up to shoulder height and lower with control. A direct biceps builder.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.description: Curl each dumbbell while keeping the elbow still. Variation: supinate the wrist (palm up) at the top to maximize biceps activation.
exercises.illustrationSummary: Both elbows bend to raise the dumbbells, then extend to lower them.
exercises.sourceDescription: Curl each dumbbell while keeping the elbow still. Variation: supinate the wrist (palm up) at the top to maximize biceps activation.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.description: Curl with the palms facing each other (neutral grip). Emphasizes the brachialis and brachioradialis, adding thickness to the arm.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The elbows flex with neutral hand orientation. Dumbbell axes rotate with the forearms rather than remaining collinear with the forearm bones.
exercises.sourceDescription: Curl with the palms facing each other (neutral grip). Emphasizes the brachialis and brachioradialis, adding thickness to the arm.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
exercises.description: Curl the E-Z bar against a preacher bench pad. Limits shoulder involvement and the range is fixed, so strict form matters.
exercises.demonstrationVariant: Seated; EZ bar and sloped arm pad
exercises.illustrationSummary: An EZ bar rises and lowers while the upper arms are supported by a preacher pad.
exercises.sourceDescription: Curl the E-Z bar against a preacher bench pad. Limits shoulder involvement and the range is fixed, so strict form matters.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.description: Curl a straight or E-Z bar attachment on a low pulley. Cables keep the muscle under constant tension through the whole rep.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The handle rises through elbow flexion with the cable routed to a low pulley.
exercises.sourceDescription: Curl a straight or E-Z bar attachment on a low pulley. Cables keep the muscle under constant tension through the whole rep.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.description: With elbows fixed at your sides, push the bar down until the arms fully extend, then return slowly. A reliable triceps finisher.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The elbows extend to move a high-pulley cable handle downward.
exercises.sourceDescription: With elbows fixed at your sides, push the bar down until the arms fully extend, then return slowly. A reliable triceps finisher.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.description: Hold a dumbbell overhead with both hands and lower it behind your head, then extend back up. Stretches and works the long head.
exercises.demonstrationVariant: Seated; one dumbbell held with two hands
exercises.illustrationSummary: A single dumbbell moves from behind the head to overhead through elbow extension.
exercises.sourceDescription: Hold a dumbbell overhead with both hands and lower it behind your head, then extend back up. Stretches and works the long head.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.description: Bench press with a shoulder-width grip so the triceps drive the movement. Heavier way to overload the triceps.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The barbell is pressed from the chest using a closer hand spacing than the standard bench-press illustration.
exercises.sourceDescription: Bench press with a shoulder-width grip so the triceps drive the movement. Heavier way to overload the triceps.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.description: Lower yourself between parallel bars until the shoulders pass the elbows, then push back up. Works the chest (leaning forward) and triceps (upright).
exercises.illustrationSummary: The suspended figure lowers and raises its torso between parallel bars.
exercises.sourceDescription: Lower yourself between parallel bars until the shoulders pass the elbows, then push back up. Works the chest (leaning forward) and triceps (upright).

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.description: Lying down, lower the E-Z bar toward your forehead keeping the upper arms still, then extend back up. Use light weight and control.
exercises.illustrationSummary: With the upper arms directed upward, elbow flexion brings the EZ bar toward the head and elbow extension moves it away.
exercises.sourceDescription: Lying down, lower the E-Z bar toward your forehead keeping the upper arms still, then extend back up. Use light weight and control.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.description: From a dead hang with an overhand grip, pull your chin over the bar and lower under control. The gold-standard upper back movement.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The torso is drawn upward toward a fixed overhead bar, then lowered.
exercises.sourceDescription: From a dead hang with an overhand grip, pull your chin over the bar and lower under control. The gold-standard upper back movement.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: Pull the wide bar to your upper chest while keeping your torso tall and ribs down. Builds the lats and works well as a pull-up progression.
exercises.demonstrationVariant: Seated; wide straight bar, front pulldown
exercises.illustrationSummary: The cable bar is drawn from overhead toward the upper chest while the figure remains seated.
exercises.sourceDescription: Pull the wide bar to your upper chest while keeping your torso tall and ribs down. Builds the lats and works well as a pull-up progression.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.description: Hinge forward with a flat back and row the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades. Thickens the mid-back and lats.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The barbell is drawn toward the lower ribs and lowered while the hip-hinged torso stays stable.
exercises.sourceDescription: Hinge forward with a flat back and row the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades. Thickens the mid-back and lats.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.description: Pull the handle to your stomach while keeping the chest proud and elbows tracking to the hips. Trains the whole back with stable form.
exercises.illustrationSummary: A cable handle moves toward the torso while the feet are supported ahead of the seat.
exercises.sourceDescription: Pull the handle to your stomach while keeping the chest proud and elbows tracking to the hips. Trains the whole back with stable form.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: Set the bar over mid-foot, brace, and stand up while keeping the bar close to your legs. Full-body posterior chain strength builder.
exercises.illustrationSummary: Hip and knee extension raise the barbell from near the floor; the arms remain nearly straight.
exercises.sourceDescription: Set the bar over mid-foot, brace, and stand up while keeping the bar close to your legs. Full-body posterior chain strength builder.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.description: Brace one hand and knee on a bench and row the dumbbell to your hip. Allows a big stretch and contraction in each side of the back.
exercises.demonstrationVariant: One hand and knee supported by a bench
exercises.illustrationSummary: The right arm rows a dumbbell; the left palm, knee and lower leg are supported on the bench.
exercises.sourceDescription: Brace one hand and knee on a bench and row the dumbbell to your hip. Allows a big stretch and contraction in each side of the back.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.description: With the bar on your upper back, sit down between your heels to at least parallel and stand back up. The foundation of leg training.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The hips and knees bend into a squat and extend while the barbell stays across the upper back.
exercises.sourceDescription: With the bar on your upper back, sit down between your heels to at least parallel and stand back up. The foundation of leg training.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.description: Hold the bar on the front of your shoulders with elbows high and squat down. Emphasizes the quads and forces an upright torso.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The figure squats with a barbell positioned in front of the shoulders.
exercises.sourceDescription: Hold the bar on the front of your shoulders with elbows high and squat down. Emphasizes the quads and forces an upright torso.

exercises.name: Barbell Lunge
exercises.description: Step forward and lower until the rear knee approaches the floor, then drive back up. Works quads, glutes and balance side to side.
exercises.demonstrationVariant: Forward step; barbell across upper back
exercises.illustrationSummary: One foot steps forward, the body lowers into a lunge, then returns to the starting position.
exercises.sourceDescription: Step forward and lower until the rear knee approaches the floor, then drive back up. Works quads, glutes and balance side to side.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.description: Extend the knees against the resistance of the machine, then lower slowly. Directly isolates the quadriceps.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The lower legs rotate upward about the knees against a padded machine roller.
exercises.sourceDescription: Extend the knees against the resistance of the machine, then lower slowly. Directly isolates the quadriceps.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.description: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and squat, elbows inside the knees. A great entry-level squat that teaches an upright, tall spine.
exercises.demonstrationVariant: One dumbbell at chest; not a kettlebell
exercises.illustrationSummary: The figure squats while holding one vertical dumbbell in front of the chest.
exercises.sourceDescription: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and squat, elbows inside the knees. A great entry-level squat that teaches an upright, tall spine.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: With soft knees, push the hips back to feel a deep hamstring stretch while lowering the bar down the legs, then stand tall. Hamstring and glute builder.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The hips move backward as the barbell lowers along the legs; the arms remain nearly straight.
exercises.sourceDescription: With soft knees, push the hips back to feel a deep hamstring stretch while lowering the bar down the legs, then stand tall. Hamstring and glute builder.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.description: Curl the legs against the machine's resistance, bringing the heels toward the glutes. Finishes the hamstrings after heavy pulls.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The knees bend to raise a padded roller behind the legs while the torso is supported on a bench.
exercises.sourceDescription: Curl the legs against the machine's resistance, bringing the heels toward the glutes. Finishes the hamstrings after heavy pulls.

exercises.name: Nordic Curl
exercises.description: Anchor your feet and lower your torso under control against the hamstrings, catching yourself with your hands. Maximal hamstring loading.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The body tilts forward about the knees with the hips extended and the ankles restrained, then returns.
exercises.sourceDescription: Anchor your feet and lower your torso under control against the hamstrings, catching yourself with your hands. Maximal hamstring loading.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.description: A wide-stance deadlift with toes turned out and arms hanging inside the knees. Shifts more load to the quads, adductors and hips.
exercises.illustrationSummary: A wide-stance barbell lift is illustrated with the hands positioned inside the knees.
exercises.sourceDescription: A wide-stance deadlift with toes turned out and arms hanging inside the knees. Shifts more load to the quads, adductors and hips.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Hold a straight-body position on forearms and toes, bracing the core and glutes. Builds endurance in the whole abdominal wall.
exercises.illustrationSummary: A still rendering shows a forearm-supported plank. There is no artificial repetition loop.
exercises.sourceDescription: Hold a straight-body position on forearms and toes, bracing the core and glutes. Builds endurance in the whole abdominal wall.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.description: Lying down, curl the shoulders toward the hips using the abs while keeping the lower back down. Isolates the upper rectus abdominis.
exercises.illustrationSummary: A short trunk lift is illustrated with the feet supported on the floor. The simplified torso does not model individual vertebrae.
exercises.sourceDescription: Lying down, curl the shoulders toward the hips using the abs while keeping the lower back down. Isolates the upper rectus abdominis.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.description: Hang from a bar and raise the legs with control, curling the hips upward. Hits the lower abs and hip flexors with full tension.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The legs lift forward while the upper body remains suspended from an overhead bar.
exercises.sourceDescription: Hang from a bar and raise the legs with control, curling the hips upward. Hits the lower abs and hip flexors with full tension.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.description: Sitting with a soft lean back, rotate the torso side to side. Trains the obliques; hold a weight to increase the load.
exercises.demonstrationVariant: Seated; feet supported; no added weight
exercises.illustrationSummary: The upper torso and joined hands rotate from side to side while the lower-body support remains in place.
exercises.sourceDescription: Sitting with a soft lean back, rotate the torso side to side. Trains the obliques; hold a weight to increase the load.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.description: Kneel under a high pulley with a rope at the head and curl the torso down. Lets you add load to the crunch safely.
exercises.illustrationSummary: A kneeling trunk-flexion pattern is illustrated with a high cable rope. The simplified torso does not model individual vertebrae.
exercises.sourceDescription: Kneel under a high pulley with a rope at the head and curl the torso down. Lets you add load to the crunch safely.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.description: With the bar over your hips and shoulders on a bench, drive through the heels to full hip extension, squeezing the glutes at the top.
exercises.demonstrationVariant: Upper back supported by bench; barbell at hips
exercises.illustrationSummary: The hips rise and lower with the upper back supported by a bench and a barbell positioned at the pelvis.
exercises.sourceDescription: With the bar over your hips and shoulders on a bench, drive through the heels to full hip extension, squeezing the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Lying down with knees bent, lift the hips until the body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders. A simple glute activator.
exercises.illustrationSummary: The hips rise from the floor while the upper back and feet remain supported.
exercises.sourceDescription: Lying down with knees bent, lift the hips until the body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders. A simple glute activator.

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
exercises.description: With an ankle strap on a low pulley, extend the leg back and squeeze the glute at the peak of the movement.
exercises.demonstrationVariant: Standing support; low cable ankle attachment
exercises.illustrationSummary: The right leg extends backward with a low cable attached near the ankle while the other leg supports the body.
exercises.sourceDescription: With an ankle strap on a low pulley, extend the leg back and squeeze the glute at the peak of the movement.
